rationale: The persistent failure notice remains outside the disclosure and now sits immediately after the menu containing the live retry controls. The unchanged notice effect reveals the message by scrolling without moving focus. The existing !won/startFailed conditions, start handler, pending-action guards, selected ingredient, round pointer and score logic are untouched. It additionally waits for ordinary disabled-button blur, verifies the entire retry button against viewport and scrollport bounds, and asserts that revealing the error does not change the pending element of focus. These are stronger assertions rather than a relaxed visibility expectation.
